items.difficulty_reason: Local-to-global smoothing at an lci point of a finite type scheme: present the local ring as localisation of a global complete intersection P, smooth P via the affine perturbation lemma, identify the singular locus with the d-th Fitting ideal of Omega over k[[t]], extract t^n in I, and localise at the prime over p; complete chain with each citation's content verified in span. Retained author proof at lines 3307-3326.
